name: cavemio-pricing-plans
title: Pricing plans
description: Plans that turn into their own checkout: pick one and its card becomes the order, seats and totals rolling, then Continue opens your checkout.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each plan is a list item with its name as a heading; the checkout slip is a labelled group that takes focus when it opens, and Escape or × returns focus to the plan’s button.
- Prices and totals are read as whole amounts; the billing note is plain text, never a live region, and the error is an alert.
- A plan with href is a real link (Contact sales); the current plan’s button is disabled and says so.
- The featured plan’s light comes from your theme: --primary-foreground mixed into --primary for the lit corner, 1px light edges and ledger rules in the same colour, so it follows your brand in light and dark. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Pricing toggle, Number roll, Stepper input, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the card and slip crossfade in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: plans
props.description: – · { id, name, description?, price: { monthly, yearly }, perSeat?, minSeats?, maxSeats?, features, featured?, badge?, cta?, href? }. Prices are per month (per seat when perSeat); yearly is the monthly rate when billed yearly.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: – · Gets { plan, billing, seats, total }. Start your checkout and redirect; throw an Error to show its message. Free plans call it straight from their button.

props.name: billing / defaultBilling / onBillingChange
props.description: — / "monthly" · The billing period; controlled or not.

props.name: currentPlanId
props.description: – · Marks the account’s plan and turns the other buttons into Upgrade to / Switch to.

props.name: currency / locale
props.description: "USD" / browser · Formats every price with Intl.

useCases.title: Billing settings
useCases.description: The account’s current plan marked, with Upgrade and Switch on the others.

useCases.title: Per-seat SaaS

features.title: The card becomes the checkout
features.description: Picking a plan turns its card into an order slip in place; the other plans step back, Escape or × goes back.

features.title: Seats and totals that add up
features.description: Per-seat plans get a stepper with your minimum and maximum; line items and the total roll as they change.

features.title: Yearly that shows its saving
features.description: The toggle’s badge is worked out from your prices, and the slip says how much yearly saves for these seats.

features.title: Checkout through your provider
features.description: onCheckout gets the plan, billing, seats and total; create the session there and redirect.

features.title: Failures stay put
features.description: If checkout can’t start, the slip keeps everything and shows your message under Try again.

features.title: A billing page too
features.description: With currentPlanId the current plan says Your plan and the others read Upgrade to or Switch to.

states.title: plans
states.description: thin line cards; the featured plan is lit from its top corner with fine ledger rules fading from the top right. Monthly/Yearly rolls every price and slides the billing note in from the side the switch moved.

states.title: checkout
states.description: The picked card turns into a slip in 460ms (the plan face slides left through a blur, the slip comes in from the right, the height eases); the other plans fade to half and settle back a little.

states.title: seats
states.description: The stepper changes the seat count; the line ("$19 × 4 seats × 12 months"), the saving and Due today roll to the new totals.

states.title: pending
states.description: Continue morphs to Opening checkout with a spinner; seats and billing are locked.

states.title: redirecting
states.description: Once onCheckout resolves, a check draws itself and the button reads Redirecting.

states.title: error
states.description: The button shakes into Try again and your message replaces "Cancel any time."; nothing else changes.

states.title: current plan
states.description: With currentPlanId the plan reads Your plan with a quiet, disabled button; others offer Upgrade to or Switch to by price.
